name: Should I manage my rental property myself or hire a property manager?

mainEntity.name: Should I manage my rental property myself or hire a property manager?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deciding between self-management and hiring a property manager depends on your time availability, experience, and proximity to the property. Self-management can save costs but requires significant time for tenant screening, maintenance, and rent collection. A property manager handles these tasks for a fee, offering expertise and convenience, particularly valuable for out-of-state investors or those with multiple properties in diverse locations like Miami and Fort Lauderdale.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose between self-management and a property manager based on your time and experience. Property managers offer expertise and convenience, especially for investors with properties in multiple locations like Miami and Fort Lauderdale.
